title: MathCamp 2026
text:
Welcome
This is the interactive companion book for MathCamp 2026, the math camp for the incoming Political Science PhD cohort. It replaces last year’s slide-based sessions (archived in Resources/Slide Decks 2025/) with interactive, web-based material built in Quarto.

title: MathCamp 2026
text:
How to use this book
Each chapter corresponds to a lecture session and includes worked examples, practice problems, and interactive visualizations (via plotly, Shiny, or similar R tooling) to build intuition alongside the math. Every session is available in two forms:

Webpage (this book) — the full written version, with more detail and worked examples.
Slides — a slideshow version for in-class use.
